final_gaps.title: Lack of Child Data Processing Controls and Parental Consent
final_gaps.description: The knowledge graph has no policies, controls, or processes addressing the processing of personal data of children, verifiable parental consent, or restrictions on child tracking and targeted advertising.
final_gaps.recommendation: Implement policies, verifiable parental consent mechanisms, and restrictions on tracking and targeted advertising for children's data.

final_gaps.title: Inadequate Incident Response and Breach Notification Workflow
final_gaps.description: The Incident Response Process currently notifies only the Compliance department within 24 hours of detection, but Section 8(6) of the Act requires that in the event of a personal data breach, intimation must also be made directly to the Data Protection Board of India.
final_gaps.recommendation: Update the Incident Response Process to include direct mandatory notifications to the Data Protection Board of India alongside internal compliance notifications.

final_gaps.title: Missing India-Based DPO and Independent Auditor Appointments
final_gaps.description: Although a DPIA control and process exist, the knowledge graph lacks controls or roles dedicated to appointing an India-based Data Protection Officer (DPO) and an independent data auditor as required.
final_gaps.recommendation: Formalize the appointment of an India-based DPO and independent data auditors within the governance framework and related processes.

final_gaps.title: Lack of Enforceable Consent Notice Mechanism
final_gaps.description: While the requirement and consent management process mention providing a notice, the knowledge graph lacks a dedicated, enforceable control or automated mechanism ensuring that notice is systematically provided.
final_gaps.recommendation: Develop automated controls and explicit workflows to systematically deliver and track consent notices.

final_gaps.title: Incomplete Data Subject Access Request Summary Processing
final_gaps.description: While a general data subject request response requirement exists, there are no specific workflows or controls ensuring that data subject access requests return the required detailed summary of processing activities.
final_gaps.recommendation: Enhance DSR handling workflows to automatically aggregate and return detailed summaries of personal data processing.

final_gaps.title: Missing Data Correction, Completion, and Updating Controls
final_gaps.description: The knowledge graph covers general request response times and event-driven erasure, but lacks specific controls governing data correction, completion, and updating requests from Data Principals.
final_gaps.recommendation: Establish dedicated policies and technical controls to handle data correction, completion, and updating requests.

final_gaps.title: Lack of Nomination Right Mechanism for Data Principals
final_gaps.description: The knowledge graph contains no control, policy, or process addressing the Data Principal's right to nominate an individual to exercise their rights upon death or incapacity.
final_gaps.recommendation: Introduce a nomination workflow allowing Data Principals to designate a representative in the event of death or incapacity.

final_gaps.title: Undefined Central Government Information Request Procedures
final_gaps.description: While a process entity ('Central Government Information Request Handling Process') exists in the knowledge graph, there are no detailed operational requirements, controls, or procedures defined for validation and execution.
final_gaps.recommendation: Document standard operating procedures and validation controls for processing Central Government information requests.

final_gaps.title: Missing Policies on Statutory Duties of Data Principals
final_gaps.description: The knowledge graph lacks any policy or terms provisions outlining or enforcing the statutory duties of Data Principals.
final_gaps.recommendation: Update terms of service or privacy policies to incorporate and communicate the statutory duties of Data Principals.

final_gaps.title: Insufficient Specificity in Cross-Border Data Transfers
final_gaps.description: While a Cross-Border Transfer Control exists, it relies generally on vendor agreements restricting transfer to 'notified countries and territories only' but does not explicitly track or incorporate specific statutory restrictions.
final_gaps.recommendation: Refine cross-border transfer controls to dynamically track and enforce specific notified country lists and restrictions.
